clearer_why: A's labels and node text are large and every edge label sits squarely on its own line, so placed/settled/card into Kafka and Stripe are unambiguous. B shows the whole system at once with a legend, but its text is small at column width and the placed/settled dashed lines cross and run together between Orders, Payments and Event bus.
looks_why: B is compact and polished: soft grouped frames, type tags, bold names, colour-coded HTTP vs background edges and a coral highlight on the checkout path. A is a tall, sparse layout with grey label boxes and heavy black lines that spans two screens.
weak_A: very tall and sparse; needs scrolling across two screens to follow the flow
weak_B: small text and tangled dashed placed/settled lines near Event bus
